claim: TanStack Table v9 entered beta in June 2026; rebuilt on TanStack Store, features are opt-in tree-shakable plugins, ~6-7kb for small tables vs 15-20kb in v8; v8's state patterns were incompatible with React Compiler.
quote: V9 has major state management improvements, is more tree-shakable, extendable, and composable while maintaining type safety, uses less memory, has broadly improved performance

claim: TanStack Table's release feed in July 2026 consists entirely of v9 betas; v9.0.0-beta.47 shipped 2026-07-13.

claim: TanStack Table is explicitly headless: no markup, no styles, no virtualization; it ships row models for sorting, filtering, faceting, grouping, aggregation, expansion, selection, sizing, pinning, visibility, ordering, pagination.
quote: Table gives you the math and state. Your app keeps the elements, classes, interactions, density, empty states, and brand-specific details. ... Virtualization stays your choice. Pair with TanStack Virtual

claim: TanStack Table's lead maintainer states he could not dedicate much time to the project in 2025 and expects shipping everything in 2026 to be a challenge.
quote: After not being able to dedicate as much time in 2025 to TanStack Table, I'm at least ending the year having mostly figured out some hard problems. It's going to be a challenge to actually organize and ship everything in 2026
